script:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local enabled = false
local toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.E

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
		enabled = not enabled
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if enabled then
			local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ReplicatorNoYield")
			if rem then
				rem:FireServer("Core", "Soru", {})
			end
		end
		task.wait(0)
	end
end)
